title: Ao no Hako Season 2

thread.title: Blue Box Season 2 • Ao no Hako Season 2 - Episode 5 discussion

opinions.point: Overall reaction was strongly enthusiastic, with many viewers calling the episode emotionally satisfying and among the season’s highlights.
Commenters especially appreciated the romance, friendship repair, and increasingly intense emotional tension.
The basketball material was praised for feeling exciting and for preserving the series’ sports-anime identity.
The ending generated excitement and anticipation, but several viewers were frustrated that it stopped at such a dramatic moment.
Animation was widely praised, though one commenter felt parts of the character interaction looked off and another questioned the protagonist’s shooting form.
Viewers enjoyed the supporting cast, including comic moments and hints of additional romantic subplots.
